results.controlIntent: a. Identify and document the types of system changes that are configuration-controlled; b. Review proposed configuration-controlled changes to the system and, with explicit consideration for security and privacy impact analyses, approve or disapprove such changes; c. Record configuration change decisions associated with the system; d. Put approved configuration-controlled changes to the system into effect; e. Keep records of configuration-controlled changes to the system for [Assignment: organization-defined time period]; f. Monitor and review activities associated with configuration-controlled changes to the system; and g. Coordinate and oversee configuration change control activities through [Assignment: organization-defined configuration change control element] that convenes [Selection (one or more): [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]; when [Assignment: organization-defined configuration change conditions]].

judgment.rationale:
Evidence from two sources reveals a mixed picture across two distinct change events:

**SATISFIED — Initial Deployment (CM-3.v2 b, c, d):**
The model registry entry (f4e4a9c3) shows model package v1 was formally approved at 2025-12-01T09:00:00Z. The CloudTrail CreateEndpoint event (c3729e87) shows the endpoint was deployed at 2025-12-01T11:00:00Z — two hours *after* approval. This temporal ordering (approve → deploy) satisfies the requirement that approved changes be put into effect only after formal approval (CM-3.v2 b, c, d). A change decision record exists in the registry.

**NOT SATISFIED — Hotfix Update (CM-3.v2 b, c, d, f):**
The CloudTrail UpdateEndpoint event (8c36b8e3) shows a hotfix deployment on 2026-03-15T14:22:00Z using config `churn-predictor-v1-hotfix`, executed by the same IAM user (data-scientist-jdoe). No corresponding model registry entry or approval record exists for this change. This means:
- The change was not reviewed or approved prior to deployment (violates CM-3.v2 b).
- No configuration change decision was recorded (violates CM-3.v2 c).
- The change was put into effect without approval (violates CM-3.v2 d).
- There is no evidence of monitoring or oversight of this change (violates CM-3.v2 f).

**Additional Gaps:**
- No evidence of a formal configuration change control board or defined change control element (CM-3.v2 g).
- No evidence of a defined retention period for change records (CM-3.v2 e).
- Security and privacy impact analyses are not documented in the available evidence (CM-3.v2 b).
gaps: No model registry entry or approval record for the 2026-03-15 hotfix deployment (churn-predictor-v1-hotfix) — human attestation needed to determine if an out-of-band approval process was followed.
No evidence of a formal Configuration Change Control Board (CCB) or equivalent governance body (CM-3.v2 g).
No evidence of security and privacy impact analyses being conducted for either change (CM-3.v2 b).
No evidence of a defined record retention period for configuration change records (CM-3.v2 e).
No evidence of periodic review or monitoring activities for configuration-controlled changes beyond the CloudTrail log itself (CM-3.v2 f).
